title: Epico C: reprioritizacao cross-list (subagent-triager read-only + topo-sort/WSJF deterministico + gate de grafo)
description:
Reprioritizacao automatica do backlog (grill de design 2026-06-26). Atende: a cada nova issue completamente especificada, reanalisa TODAS, acha bloqueios, define a ordem correta.

ARQUITETURA (split LLM/deterministico, espelha a two-layer verification do cam): a analise PER-ISSUE (blockedBy + WSJF daquela issue) JA E o output do grill (epico B) — NAO ha agente per-issue separado (seria redundante; o grill tem o contexto mais quente). O trabalho NOVO e o CROSS-LIST:
- subagent-triager (NOVO, read-only, classe auditor, entra na allowlist do hook): consome as arestas+WSJF que cada grill gravou, e reconcilia conflitos CROSS-issue com LLM fino (a issue nova diz blocked-by-X: cria ciclo? bloqueia alguma existente?).
- ranking DETERMINISTICO em TS (nao LLM): topological sort de Kahn das camadas que respeitam dependencia; DENTRO de cada camada in-degree-zero, ordena por WSJF desc (CoD/JobSize). Garante: nada ranqueado antes do seu bloqueador, e valor-alto-esforco-baixo ganha entre os desbloqueados.

GATE DETERMINISTICO do grafo (pega erro de modelo): valida aciclicidade (Kahn detecta ciclo), integridade referencial (blockedBy aponta pra id existente), sem self-reference, direcao unica (blockedBy fonte; blocks derivado). Ciclo -> REJEITA o grafo proposto, MANTEM o rank anterior, ESCALA pro operador (CAM-X <-> CAM-Y); nunca dropa aresta em silencio.

AUTONOMIA: trigger automatico na promocao idea->specified (rerankeia o conjunto specified inteiro) + comando manual cam triage. APLICA o rank autonomo (gate deterministico e a rede de seguranca) e NARRA o diff (o que subiu/desceu, blockedBy novos); o operador SOBRESCREVE qualquer aresta ou componente WSJF (override que o triager respeita).

ONDE TOCAR: novo subagent-triager (.claude/agents + allowlist do hook CAM-102), modulo TS deterministico de topo-sort+WSJF+gate (estilo src/release, injetavel, hermetico), o trigger pos-specified, comando cam triage. Testes: topo-sort, deteccao de ciclo, ordering WSJF, reconciliacao.

DEPENDENCIAS: BLOQUEADO POR CAM-106 (campos rank/blockedBy/wsjf) e CAM-107 (consome os grills). Paralelo ao epico D. Cross-ref CAM-102 (a politica por capacidade ja libera o triager read-only).

PRIORIDADE: P2. WSJF (https://framework.scaledagile.com/wsjf) + topological sort Kahn.

spec.scope: Slice 1 of Epico C (cross-list reprioritization): the DETERMINISTIC core only. OUT of scope and filed as a separate Slice-2 issue: the LLM cross-list reconciler (subagent-triager), the auto-trigger on idea-to-specified promotion, diff auto-narration to the orchestrator, and persistent operator overrides. No LLM anywhere in this slice. Deliverable: (1) a hand-rolled Kahn topological-sort plus WSJF ranking module in src/issues/ (pure, injectable, hermetic, src/release style) that computes a dense 1-based rank field over the {stage:specified, status:open} set; (2) a graph gate (cycle detection via Kahn plus reuse of checkReferentialIntegrity for missing-id and self-ref) that hard-fails transactionally before any write; (3) a deterministic cam triage CLI that reads the backlog from main, computes ranks, runs the gate, and writes the rank field to issues.local.json on main via commit-tree (never touching the work branch); (4) extraction of the shared on-main commit-tree helper from its 3 existing verbatim copies (issue-file, issue-specify, journal-append) into one module that all callers plus cam triage use, which closes CAM-124.
acceptanceCriteria: A pure ranking function in src/issues/ computes a dense 1-based rank over the {stage:specified,status:open} set: Kahn layers over blockedBy edges internal to the set (shipped blockers treated as satisfied and ignored), within each in-degree-zero layer sorted by WSJF descending then numeric id ascending [oracle: bun test (unit tests for layering, WSJF order, id tie-break)]

WSJF equals (value plus timeCriticality plus riskReduction) divided by jobSize; a specified issue with missing wsjf or jobSize less-than-or-equal-0 is treated as WSJF 0 (sorts last in its layer) with a warning, never a crash or divide-by-zero [oracle: bun test (missing-wsjf and jobSize-0 cases assert WSJF 0 plus warn, no throw)]

Kahn detects a cycle (nodes whose in-degree never reaches zero); the gate hard-fails, names the cycle path (e.g. CAM-X to CAM-Y to CAM-X), writes NO rank, and exits non-zero [oracle: bun test (cyclic graph rejected, ranks unchanged) plus file-assert the cycle ids appear in the error]

The gate reuses checkReferentialIntegrity to hard-fail on a blockedBy pointing to a non-existent id or a self-reference, transactionally (no rank written), naming the offending edge [oracle: bun test (missing-id and self-ref each rejected with no write)]

A specified issue blockedBy an idea, abandoned, or otherwise non-shipped-non-specified id is ranked by its intra-set position and emits a warning, not a hard fail [oracle: bun test (cross-stage blocker ranked plus warning, exit 0)]

cam triage writes the computed rank onto every {specified,open} issue in issues.local.json and commits to main via commit-tree (the issue-file and specify family) without checking out or touching the current work branch; all-ranks-or-none [oracle: real-git integration test: rank lands on main, work-branch HEAD unchanged]
When computed ranks equal current ranks, cam triage is a no-op: no commit is created and it prints a no-change line [oracle: integration test: second consecutive run produces no new commit]

cam triage prints the resulting ranked order (id, rank, WSJF, stage) plus a diff versus prior rank (up, down, new, unchanged) and any warnings, and emits CAM_TRIAGE_RANKED=<n> changed=<m> sha=<commit-or-none> on success or CAM_TRIAGE_REJECTED=cycle:... on hard-fail [oracle: file-assert grep the sentinel lines in a captured-stdout test]

The on-main commit-tree plumbing (temp index, hash-object, update-index, write-tree, commit-tree -p main, update-ref) is extracted into a single shared module used by createLocalIssueOnMain, specifyIssueOnMain, the journal-append writer, and cam triage; the 3 prior verbatim copies are removed [oracle: file-assert grep shows one shared helper imported by all 4 callers and no duplicated commit-tree block; bun test parity tests for the 3 refactored callers stay green]
Typecheck passes and the full gate spine is green, including jscpd dup not regressed (the dedup of the commit-tree helper is part of the deliverable) [oracle: bun run check:all]
gotchas: Slice 1 is deterministic ONLY: do NOT add subagent-triager, the auto-trigger on promotion, diff auto-narration, or persistent operator overrides; those are Slice 2 (separate issue). No LLM anywhere in this slice.

cam triage is a deterministic CLI (family: cam issue --file-local, cam journal append, cam ship --finalize), NOT a thin-proxy injected into the orchestrator pane. It runs in-process and commits to main directly.

Reuse, do not reinvent: src/issues/graph.ts already has deriveBlocks and checkReferentialIntegrity; graph.ts line 47 explicitly defers full cycle-rejection to this issue. blocks is derived from blockedBy, never stored (single-direction).
Kahn is hand-rolled in TS (zero extra dependency, cam ethos). Pure, injectable, hermetic like src/release; tests must not shell out (inject spawnFn).

The commit-tree-to-main extraction (closes CAM-124) must keep the 3 existing callers byte-behaviorally identical: add parity tests. A 4th verbatim copy would trip the jscpd dup gate at ship, so the extraction is load-bearing, not cosmetic.

Universe is {stage:specified, status:open}. planned is a defined-but-unreachable stage today (nothing sets it); idea, shipped, abandoned are excluded. rank is the first-ever writer of the rank field (select.ts only reads it).
Transactional plus idempotent: the gate runs before any write; on hard-fail keep prior ranks and exit 1; on no-change skip the commit (no empty commit).
Slice 1 adds no new agent, so do NOT touch templates/ or the hook allowlist; the subagent-triager allowlist entry belongs to Slice 2.
domainTerms: triage: the deterministic cross-list reprioritization pass that recomputes rank over the specified set (Slice 1 = manual cam triage; Slice 2 adds the LLM reconciler plus auto-trigger).
rank: dense 1-based integer over {specified,open}, the output of topo-sort plus WSJF, consumed by selectPlannableIssue (ascending). First written by cam triage.
WSJF: Weighted Shortest Job First = Cost of Delay divided by JobSize, where CoD = value plus timeCriticality plus riskReduction (SAFe). Higher = higher priority within a Kahn layer.
Kahn layer: the set of in-degree-zero nodes at a step of Kahn algorithm (issues whose blockers are all satisfied); ranked together, WSJF-descending.

graph gate: deterministic validation (acyclicity via Kahn, referential integrity, no self-ref, single-direction) that hard-fails transactionally before any rank is written; the safety net under the future Slice-2 LLM reconciler.

on-main commit-tree helper: the shared git-plumbing primitive (temp index, write-tree, commit-tree -p main, update-ref) that mutates issues.local.json or journal.md on main without touching the work branch; extracted here from 3 copies (closes CAM-124).
